# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of SpectreCheck seriously. If you believe you have found a security vulnerability or a way to bypass audit detection heuristics, please do NOT file a public issue.

Instead, please send a responsible disclosure report to the repository maintainer via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting or via email.

Please include:
* Description of the vulnerability and attack vector.
* Browser version, operating system, and hardware details.
* Minimal reproduction steps or proof-of-concept code.
* Potential remediation or mitigation strategies.

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and work with you on a patch prior to public disclosure.
